title: Act III, Scene III
focus: Romeo's despair in the Friar's cell

teacherSummary.text: Romeo hides in the Friar's cell, despairing at banishment. The Nurse arrives; Romeo draws a dagger to kill himself; the Friar stops him and lays out a plan: spend the night with Juliet, flee to Mantua, and wait until the marriage can be announced.
